name: Sales Report
query:
SELECT
    si.name AS "Invoice ID:Link/Sales Invoice:120",
    si.posting_date AS "Invoice Date:Date:120",
    si.creation AS "Creation Date:Date:120",
    si.po_no AS "Customer PO No.:Data:150",
    si.po_date AS "Customer PO Date:Date:150",
    c.customer_code AS "Customer Code:Link/Customer:150",
    si.customer_name AS "Customer Name:Data:150",

    sii.party_item_code AS "Party Item Code:Data:150",
    sii.item_code AS "Item Code:Data:120",
    sii.item_name AS "Item Name:Link/Item:140",
    sii.description AS "Item Description:Data:220",
    sii.qty AS "Qty:Float:80",

    sii.rate AS " Item Rate :HTML:120",
    

    sii.amount AS " Amount :HTML:120",
    
    

    dn.posting_date AS "Delivery Date:Date:120",

    si.conversion_rate AS "Exchange Rate :Float:140",
    
    

    c.business_region_name AS "Business Region Name:Data:190",
    ad.city AS "City:Data:120",
    ad.state AS "State:Data:120",
    ad.country AS "Country:Data:120",
    st.sales_person AS "Sales Person:Data:150",

    CASE
        WHEN ad.country = 'India' THEN 'Domestic'
        ELSE 'Export'
    END AS "Domestic/Export:Data:150",

    IFNULL(ip.price_list_rate, 0) AS "Item Purchase Rate:Currency:180",
    '' AS "OldNewFlg:Data:100",
    '' AS "Business Activity:Data:150",
    '' AS "Business Vertical:Data:150"

FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    ON sii.parent = si.name

LEFT JOIN `tabDynamic Link` dl
    ON dl.link_name = si.customer
    AND dl.link_doctype = 'Customer'
    AND dl.parenttype = 'Address'

LEFT JOIN `tabAddress` ad
    ON ad.name = dl.parent

LEFT JOIN `tabDynamic Link` dl2
    ON dl2.parent = ad.name
    AND dl2.link_doctype = 'Customer'

LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` sc
    ON sc.name = dl2.link_name

LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` st
    ON st.parent = si.name

LEFT JOIN `tabItem Price` ip
    ON ip.item_code = sii.item_code
    AND ip.buying = 1
    AND ip.selling = 0

LEFT JOIN `tabDelivery Note Item` dni
    ON sii.dn_detail = dni.name

LEFT JOIN `tabDelivery Note` dn
    ON dn.name = dni.parent

LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c
    ON c.name = si.customer

LEFT JOIN `tabCurrency` cur
    ON cur.name = si.currency

LEFT JOIN `tabCurrency` base_cur
    ON base_cur.name = si.currency

ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC;
